build_masked_transform: build a masked optimizer transform that applies a boolean mask to selectively update optimizer state
test_masked_sgd: test the masked SGD optimizer with static boolean mask and callable mask function
test_masked_prefix_mask: test the masked transform with prefix mask that applies to parent nodes of the updates pytree
test_masked_nested: test nested masked transforms where outer and inner masks combine to selectively apply updates
test_masked_callable_pytree: test the masked transform with callable pytree nodes like equinox modules
